Surkhon vs Andijan Live Stream: Kickoff Time, How to Watch & Match Preview

Match Overview

Surkhon and Andijan meet in the Uzbekistan Super League on 19 November 2026 with kickoff scheduled for 13:00 GMT. The fixture takes place at Surkhon's home venue, which has not been officially confirmed at the time of writing. Both sides sit on 31 points after 27 matches, with Andijan occupying 10th place on goal difference and Surkhon 11th. A win for either team would provide a valuable buffer above the relegation play-off zone and could push them towards a top-half finish.

Surkhon enter the match on a run of five consecutive draws, while Andijan have lost three of their last five outings. The reverse fixture in October 2025 ended in a 4-0 victory for Surkhon, their largest win in this head-to-head rivalry. With both teams struggling for consistency in the second half of the season, this encounter carries significant weight in the battle for mid-table security.

Why This Match Matters

Both teams are locked on 31 points, six points clear of the relegation play-off place occupied by Xorazm (26 points) and eleven points above the automatic relegation zone. Andijan sit 10th with a superior goal difference (-6 compared to Surkhon's -9), meaning a draw would maintain their positional advantage. A victory for Surkhon would see them leapfrog Andijan on goal difference if they win by two or more goals.

Neither side is in contention for continental qualification, with the top five separated by a 19-point gap. The primary objective for both clubs is to secure a top-ten finish and avoid the end-of-season play-off. Andijan's recent form (LLDLL) suggests vulnerability, while Surkhon's five straight draws (DDDDD) indicate resilience but an inability to convert draws into wins. Match Overview

Qatar U17 and Panama U17 meet in the FIFA U-17 World Cup Group A on 19 November 2026. Kickoff is scheduled for 15:30 GMT. The match is part of the opening round of group-stage fixtures, with both teams yet to play a competitive match in the tournament. The venue has not been officially confirmed by the organising committee. Qatar U17 qualified as hosts of the 2025 AFC U-17 Asian Cup, while Panama U17 earned their place through the CONCACAF U-17 Championship. Both sides will be aiming for a positive start in a group that also includes Greece U17 and Egypt U17.
